thread:
lila: heads up — seeing ~30 leads/hr reach the 'enriched' stage but ~10% aren't getting an owner after enrichment. spotted in HS logs and SF shows them as Unassigned. :eyes:
ben: ugh, that's the RR workflow hitting a timeout? any recent changes to the enrichment callouts?
sam: enrichment lambda logs show a lot of 504s to the enrichment service between 02:10-02:18 UTC, TTL expired, HS marked as 'enriched' but webhook failed for owner assignment. quick metric: ~45 fails in last 24h.
lila: exact — HS shows enrichment OK but the downstream workflow that triggers owner rotation is timing out and HS flags the lead as enriched_without_owner. broken fallback.
hs-bot: Alert: 1876543210 - HubSpot workflow failure rate > 5% for "enrichment -> assign_owner" (last 1h). https://hubspot.company/alerts/1876543210
ben: temporary mitigation: set HubSpot workflow to assign a default owner (marketing-inbox) when assignment fails, and increase workflow action timeout to 30s. will that reduce unowned spikes? :thumbsup:
anna: agree with temp fix. also let's widen the SLA window for handoff from 30m -> 2h while we triage, to avoid escalation noise and duplicate outreach. I can update playbook and notify SDRs.
sam: I can run a one-off SF claim script to backfill currently unassigned leads (filter: lead_status = "enriched_without_owner"). here's the curl I'll run (will run as a job):
```
# backfill unowned leads to marketing-inbox
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.company/lead-claim" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $JOB_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"filter":"enriched_without_owner","claim_to":"marketing-inbox","reason":"temporary_backfill_1876543210"}'
```
ben: after temp fixes, we should patch HS -> SF mapping: make sure the webhook retries are enabled and integration honors 5xx backoff, and add a dead-letter queue for failed owner assignments. I can work with eng-infra to set retries.
lila: assign owners: ben (workflow patch), sam (backfill job), anna (SLA/playbook update). timeline: aim to have temp config + backfill within 1 hour. can you confirm?
ben: will toggle default owner and timeout in HS workflow in next 20m, I'll post the change log here.
sam: starting backfill in 10m, will post results.
anna: I'll message SDRs in #sales and update the playbook doc.
ben: change applied: set fallback owner -> marketing-inbox, action timeout -> 30s, added 3 retry attempts. HS workflow ID: 998877. Monitor and revert if bad. :white_check_mark:
sam: backfill done — 42 leads claimed to marketing-inbox, no dupes. logs: https://internal-logs/1876543210/backfill (summaries attached).
lila: thanks team. next steps: ben to open a JIRA for persistent fix (HS webhook retries + DLQ + circuit-breaker on enrichment), sam to add alerting for enrichment 504s, anna to finalize SLA change & comms. I'll close this thread when JIRA is created. :sparkles:
